objective: Parse PNG Parts and clean 8-bit RGB raster PSD files into a deterministic, validated AssetSpec without AI rigging.
inScope: PNG Parts parser with an optional composition manifest and deterministic flat-directory fallback
8-bit RGB raster PSD parser preserving group hierarchy, visibility, bounds, layer references, alpha, pivot candidate, and Photoshop draw order
Additive AssetSpec 0.1 fields for groups, visibility, and exact 8-bit alpha masks
AssetSpec semantic validation, CLI entry points, golden fixtures, negative tests, and regression checks
outOfScope: AI rigging, mesh generation, bone inference, weights, animation, and Gate 3+ features
PSD text, adjustment, smart-object, vector, mask, effect, clipping, partial-opacity, and non-normal blend compositing
Automatic reconstruction of canvas placement from unrelated PNG files without a manifest
implementationSummary: PNG parsing reads actual 8-bit pixel alpha, takes composition bounds/order/groups from a validated manifest or uses sorted flat filenames with x=y=0. PSD parsing reads a layered PSD byte stream, walks top-first layers/groups, reverses raster leaves to backmost-first drawOrder, and rejects unsupported layer semantics instead of silently flattening them. Both emit JSON-compatible AssetSpec 0.1 with exact run-length-encoded alpha and alpha-bounds-center pivot candidates; source bytes and images remain untouched. CLI only dispatches parsers and writes new output files, never overwriting an existing output.
externalFormatEvidence: ag-psd official README documents readPsd(useRawData), getLayerImageData, and memory limits: https://github.com/Agamnentzar/ag-psd/blob/master/README.md
ag-psd official PSD notes document top-to-bottom children order and layer bounds: https://github.com/Agamnentzar/ag-psd/blob/master/README_PSD.md
pngjs official README documents decoded RGBA pixel data: https://github.com/pngjs/pngjs/blob/main/README.md

checks.name: clean install and full verification
checks.evidence: npm ci --ignore-scripts completed from package-lock.json with 0 reported vulnerabilities; npm run verify then passed Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript build/typecheck, 4 Vitest files and all 25 tests. npm run verify passed again after the final parser validation and Jev runner edits.

checks.name: PNG Parts golden and determinism
checks.evidence: A two-layer PNG composition with explicit group, display scaling, distinct pixel/display dimensions, 8-bit alpha, transparent bounds, pivot, and reversed manifest order equals fixtures/assets/png-parts.expected.json. The same input was serialized byte-for-byte identically on 20 further parses. A manifest-free directory test proves codepoint filename order and explicitly flat x=y=0 placement.

checks.name: PSD golden and determinism
checks.evidence: The test writes a true layered PSD byte stream in memory with a hidden group and two raster leaves, parses that byte stream, and compares full output to fixtures/assets/psd.expected.json. Assertions independently check group visibility, parentId, exact bounds, alpha, virtual layer source path, pivot, backmost-first draw order, and repeat serialization identity. No proprietary or user PSD is modified or committed.

checks.name: validation and negative inputs
checks.evidence: Tests cover alpha RLE round-trip including partial transparency; path traversal; missing/non-group parent; corrupt PNG; malformed PSD; invalid alpha run length; and unsupported PSD opacity. Parsers also enforce input byte, dimension, pixel, and layer limits and reject unsupported PSD compositing or layer types. Errors carry structured ValidationReport issue codes.

checks.name: CLI smoke
checks.evidence: npm run parse:png -- fixtures/spine/minimal/images <temporary output> and npm run parse:psd -- <temporary synthetic PSD> <temporary output> both completed; produced JSON passed AssetSpec schema validation, and temporary files were removed.

checks.name: Gate 0 and Gate 1 regression
checks.evidence: All 18 previously approved Gate 0+1 tests remain and pass in the 25-test suite, including the Spine 4.0.64 golden, runtime, CLI, and 100-run determinism checks. Existing AssetSpec objects remain valid because the new groups/visibility/alpha fields are optional and schema ID stays AssetSpec-0.1. Core and Spine adapter implementations are unchanged; the new assets package depends only on schemas and parsing libraries.

knownLimitations: PNG Parts without a composition manifest cannot infer original x/y, display size, hierarchy, or authored order; filename ordering and x=y=0 are explicit fallback behavior.

PSD support intentionally accepts only clean 8-bit RGB raster layers; unsupported compositing and specialized layers fail closed. The PSD fixture is generated by ag-psd, not exported by Photoshop; a user-supplied production PSD interoperability check remains future evidence, not claimed here.
PSD part sourcePath uses a virtual #layer/<index-path> suffix to identify a raster layer within the original PSD; it is not an extracted PNG file.
Alpha masks preserve per-pixel opacity, but color image bytes remain referenced in the source files; Gate 2 does not produce a separate texture atlas or Spine project.

definitionOfDone.criterion: PNG Parts parse to validated and serializable AssetSpec with bounds, alpha, pivot, and stable order
PSD raster layers parse to validated and serializable AssetSpec with hierarchy, bounds, alpha, and stable order
Parser fixtures, negative cases, and prior-Gate regression pass
No AI rigging or later-Gate implementation is introduced
